preconditions.description: The dimensions of the museum and the number of starting positions must be within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(row in {'*', '.'} for row in museum) and len(museum) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in museum)
preconditions.description: The museum must be a valid grid of n rows and m columns, with each cell being either '.' or '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m and museum[x - 1][y - 1] == '.' for x, y in start_positions)
preconditions.description: All starting positions must be within the grid and located in empty cells.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k integers, one for each starting position.
Each output integer must represent a non-negative number of pictures Igor can see from the corresponding starting position.
